page.layout: One printed page, an alphabetical index in lines with page numbers at the right; a centred heading "INDEX." at the top; section letters D, E, F, G centred between groups; catchword-like running line at foot "H. Ha-" at the lower right; signature "O 3" at the foot centre.

page.notes: The first letters of the D, E, F and G entries are large decorative initials; the initial "D" of Dactyli and "E" of Echites are read with [?] where the shape is uncertain. Several entries are set in tight spacing and may be misread; the page number "O 3" is a signature, not a page number. Heading "INDEX." is letter-spaced in the scan. Faint show-through text from the reverse side is ignored.
